reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the 1–10 person owner-operator with calm, grounded tone and no sales CTA, though it briefly slips into first-person singular 'I' instead of Bareni's standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The argument is clear, well-structured, and easy to grasp on a first read, distinguishing fuzzy intuition from traceable operational signals.
reasons.actionability: Outlines an immediate, concrete manual diagnostic step (reviewing one month of lapses to inspect existing data trails) while keeping decision authority with the owner.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsupported claims, invented numbers, or customer references, correctly identifying existing text data trails as a prerequisite for automation.
